newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Libyan minister in Morocco to boost cooperation.
newsitem.headline: Libyan minister in Morocco to boost cooperation.

text.p: Visiting Libyan Industry and Mining Minister Muftah Azzouz discussed ways to reinforce cooperation with Morocco in talks with Prime Minister Abdellatif Filali, Moroccan news agency MAP said on Thursday.
Muftah Azzouz who arrived on Wednesday, heading a team of businessmen, said on arrival that his visit "is a positive step towards reinforcement of cooperation between the two countries".
